hints: Focus on assigning an oxidation number to every element before and after the reaction, starting with the easy rules for H and O.
Check sulfur first, it goes from -2 in $\text{H}_2\text{S}$ to +4 in $\text{SO}_2$, so work out that change.
Now track oxygen from 0 to -2 and hydrogen from +1 to +1, then see which of the three statements matches the real increases and decreases.
walkthrough:
**Assign oxidation numbers to all species**

Remember the simple rules. H is +1 when with non-metals, O is -2 in oxides, and free elements are 0.

$$\text{In H}_2\text{S: H = +1, S = -2}$$
$$\text{In O}_2\text{: O = 0}$$
$$\text{In SO}_2\text{: O = -2, S = +4}$$
$$\text{In H}_2\text{O: H = +1, O = -2}$$

**Test statement 1 about sulfur**

Sulfur changes from -2 to +4. That is an increase, which means oxidation and loss of electrons.

$$\text{Change = (+4) - (-2) = +6}$$

**Test statements 2 and 3 about oxygen and hydrogen**

Oxygen changes from 0 to -2. That is a decrease of 2, so it is reduced, not increased.
Hydrogen stays at +1 in both $\text{H}_2\text{S}$ and $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, so there is no change at all.

$$\text{O: 0 to -2 = decrease by 2}$$
$$\text{H: +1 to +1 = no change}$$

**Conclude which statements are correct**

Only statement 1 is true. Statements 2 and 3 are false.
This combination corresponds to 1 only is correct.

options.A: Incorrect. This would mean all three statements are correct. Statement 1 is right, but oxygen decreases not increases, and hydrogen does not change, so 2 and 3 fail.
options.B: Incorrect. This would mean 1 and 2 are correct. While sulfur does increase by 6, oxygen goes from 0 in $\text{O}_2$ to -2 in products, a decrease by 2, so statement 2 is the opposite of the truth.
options.C: Incorrect. This would mean 2 and 3 are correct. Both are wrong. Oxygen is reduced (decrease), and hydrogen stays at +1 throughout, so it is a spectator in redox terms.
options.D: Correct. Only statement 1 is correct. Sulfur is oxidised from -2 to +4, an increase of 6, while oxygen decreases and hydrogen is unchanged.
